Senior DevOps Engineer__ (1).docx:

About Us 

Straive Private Limited (Erstwhile LearningMate Solutions Pvt. Ltd) is is a global leader in data analytics and AI operationalization, helping enterprises embed advanced AI and data capabilities into core business workflows to deliver measurable business outcomes and ROI. With a workforce of ~20,000 professionals serving 350+clients across 30+ markets, Straive combines technical scale with deep domain expertise. A key differentiator is its network of over 6,000 subject matter experts who specialize in managing and enriching complex, unstructured data—enabling organizations to build AI systems grounded in accuracy, context, and business relevance. The company continues to earn recognition from leading industry analysts and was recently named a Leader in AIM’s 2026 Generative AI and Data Engineering PeMa Quadrants. Backed by EQT — a purpose-driven global investment organization which was ranked among the world’s leading private equity firms by PEI in 2025 — Straive is positioned as a high-value alternative to traditional IT services providers, combining domain-led intelligence with AI execution at scale.

About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our growing engineering team. The ideal candidate will have 5–8 years of professional experience, a strong background in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and configuration management, and a passion for automating processes and improving system reliability. This role is pivotal in ensuring the stability, scalability, and performance of our core products.

Key Responsibilities
●	CI/CD Pipeline Management: Design, implement, and maintain robust, automated continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using tools like Team Foundation Server, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions.
●	Infrastructure Management (IaC): Manage and provision cloud infrastructure (AWS (must have) /Azure/GCP (optional)) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, primarily Terraform or CloudFormation/ARM Templates.
●	Webservers: IIS, App pools, Apache, Nginx
●	Experience of the build and deployment process of  Microsoft .Net based web applications using MSBuild along with deployment scripts creation using Powershell on AWS servers and services.
●	Experience of the build and deployment process of Angular + Node and .Net core based web applications and containers using docker along with deployment scripts creation using shell + powershell  scripting  
●	Containerization & Orchestration: Deploy, scale, and manage containerized applications using Beanstalk, ECS, Docker and Kubernetes.
●	Monitoring and Alerting: Implement and manage comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog/NewRelic, ELK stack) to ensure high availability and proactive issue detection.
●	Automation & Scripting: Write and maintain scripts (e.g., Powershell, Python, Bash, or Groovy) to automate repetitive tasks, system maintenance, and deployment processes.
●	Security & Compliance: Implement security best practices within the infrastructure and pipelines (e.g., vulnerability scanning, secret management).
●	Collaboration: Work closely with software development and QA teams to troubleshoot environment issues, define release strategies, and implement necessary infrastructure changes.
●	System Reliability: Participate in on-call rotations and incident response, perform root cause analysis, and continuously drive improvements for system reliability and performance.
●	Collaboration: Work closely with software development and QA teams, and interact directly with international stakeholders and customers to troubleshoot environment issues, define release strategies, and implement necessary infrastructure changes.
●	Hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence within agile environments, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams through daily standups, sprint ceremonies, and regular team syncs to ensure transparent communication and efficient delivery.
●	Hands-on experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, enabling continuous validation of application quality. Skilled in orchestrating unit, integration, and end-to-end tests within build workflows to ensure reliable deployments, faster feedback loops, and consistent delivery across environment

Required Qualifications & Skills (5–8 Years Experience)
●	Proven experience (5–8 years) as a Sr. DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), or similar role.
●	Cloud Expertise: Expert-level proficiency with at least one major public cloud provider (AWS,).
●	Containerization: Deep working knowledge of Docker and experience with an orchestration platform like Kubernetes (K8s) & Amazon ECS.
●	IaC: Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Cloudformation.
●	CI/CD Tools: Extensive experience configuring and managing CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
●	Operating Systems: Solid understanding of Linux/Unix administration and networking concepts.
●	Scripting: Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Powershell, Python, Bash).
●	Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of troubleshooting complex distributed systems.
●	Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially for documenting processes and communicating with cross-functional teams & customers

Good to Have (Certifications & Extras)
●	Certifications: Professional certifications in Cloud Computing (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, 
●	Configuration Management: Experience with configuration management tools like Ansible (optional)
●	Zero downtime deployment, blue-green, rolling update concepts 
●	AI toolsets & automation workflow tools. 
●	Database Management: Experience with managing and optimizing SQL/NoSQL databases in a cloud environment.
●	Networking: Knowledge of advanced networking concepts (VPC/VNet peering, load balancers, firewalls).
Security Tools: Experience with service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio) or specialized security tooling.

To:


Hi,

Following our review of your application, we are pleased to invite you for a face-to-face interview for the position of DevOps  Role

The details of the interview are as follows:

📅 Date:19th Nov '2026
🕙 Time: 10.30 AM
📍 Location: 1st Floor, Signet, Cessna Business park, Embassy Tech Square Main Rd, Kaverappa Layout, Kadubeesanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103.

Contact Person: Shakthi 
Contact Number: 8105537431

Please bring the following with you:

A copy of your updated resume/CV (Hard copy/Soft Copy)
A valid government-issued photo ID proof (e.g., Aadhar card, Passport, Voter ID, Driving License).
Please bring your laptop for final coding round. 

Note: Please confirm your availability for this interview slot by replying to this email by [ideally today].

JD - AWS Role 

4+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), cloud operations, or application production support.
Strong practical understanding of AWS cloud services, including compute, storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
Good Linux administration skills, including system troubleshooting, performance analysis, log investigation, and service management.
Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD, including pipeline configuration, execution, troubleshooting, YAML files, variables, artifacts, and GitLab Runners.
Mandatory hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), preferably Terraform, including infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, state management, and troubleshooting deployment issues.
Working knowledge of Git, branching strategies, merge requests, and version control workflows.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, ports, routing, load balancers, and AWS security groups.
Ability to systematically investigate and resolve infrastructure, application, and deployment issues using logs, metrics, monitoring tools, and dependency analysis.
Working knowledge of Python or Shell scripting for operational automation and troubleshooting.
Strong problem-solving skills, communication, collaboration, willingness to learn, and ownership of incidents through resolution.
Preferred Skills and Experience

Basic SQL knowledge for application and database-related operational investigations.
Experience with AWS monitoring and logging services, particularly Amazon CloudWatch.
Familiarity with incident, problem, and change management processes in production environments.
Exposure to operational automation, proactive monitoring, alert optimization, and root cause analysis (RCA).
Understanding of cloud infrastructure best practices, including security, reliability, availability, and cost optimization.
Experience supporting containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, or Amazon EKS would be an advantage.

JD - Azure Data DevOps 
Experience - 5+ yrs

Mandatory Skills

Strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure Cloud.
Good understanding of Azure services such as Compute, Storage, Event Hub, Event Subscription, Storage Queue, and PaaS services.
Basic understanding of Azure AI Foundry and AI-related Azure service setup.
Good Azure networking basics: VNet, subnet, routing, and basic troubleshooting.
Strong knowledge of Terraform, especially:
Terraform state
plan / apply
troubleshooting failures
migration risks
Terraform Enterprise concepts
Strong Python  scripting.
Experience using Python for API integration, automation, JSON/YAML handling, and internal tooling.
Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines.
Ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures.
Comfortable with YAML and JSON.
Ability to troubleshoot Azure infrastructure/platform issues.
Ability to collect logs/evidence and coordinate with network/app/Microsoft support teams.
Basic awareness of agentic AI / LLM concepts.
Awareness of security and cost best practices.
Good to Have Skills

Hands-on experience with Harness.
Hands-on experience with Terraform Enterprise.
Exposure to LangGraph / LangChain.
Exposure to agentic AI workflows or skill creation.
Exposure to Claude or enterprise LLM integrations.
Knowledge of Azure ML Workspace, model registry, and managed endpoints.
MLOps / LLMOps knowledge.
FinOps / Azure cost optimization experience.
Azure certifications: AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-500.

About Wissen Technology

Wissen Technology, established in 2015 and part of the Wissen Group (founded in 2000), is a specialized technology consulting company. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality solutions for global organizations across Banking & Finance, Telecom, and Healthcare domains.
 
Here’s why Wissen Technology stands out:
 
Global Presence: Offices in US, India, UK, Australia, Mexico, and Canada.
Expert Team: Wissen Group comprises over 4500 highly skilled professionals worldwide, with Wissen Technology contributing 1700 of these experts. Our team includes graduates from prestigious institutions such as Wharton, MIT, IITs, IIMs, and NITs.
Recognitions: Great Place to Work® Certified.
Featured as a Top 20 AI/ML Vendor by CIO Insider (2020).
Impressive Growth: Achieved 400% revenue growth in 5 years without external funding.
Successful Projects: Delivered $1 billion worth of projects to 50+ Fortune 500 companies.
 
For more details:
 Website: www.wissen.com 
Wissen Thought leadership : https://www.wissen.com/articles/ 
 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/wissen-technology/ 

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact. We look forward to meeting you.




Thanks & Regards,

Shakthi.M
Consultant-Talent Acquisition

Wissen Technology

emails.subject: Fwd: JD - DevOps AWS - Wissen Technology
emails.body:
From: Shakthi M <shakthi.m@wissen.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 5:14 PM
Subject: JD - DevOps AWS - Wissen Technology
To:


Hi, 


4+years of relevant experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), cloud operations, or application production support.
Strong practical understanding of AWS cloud services, including compute, storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
Good Linux administration skills, including system troubleshooting, performance analysis, log investigation, and service management.
Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD, including pipeline configuration, execution, troubleshooting, YAML files, variables, artifacts, and GitLab Runners.
Mandatory hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), preferably Terraform, including infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, state management, and troubleshooting deployment issues.
Working knowledge of Git, branching strategies, merge requests, and version control workflows.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, ports, routing, load balancers, and AWS security groups.
Ability to systematically investigate and resolve infrastructure, application, and deployment issues using logs, metrics, monitoring tools, and dependency analysis.
Working knowledge of Python or Shell scripting for operational automation and troubleshooting.
Strong problem-solving skills, communication, collaboration, willingness to learn, and ownership of incidents through resolution.
Preferred Skills and Experience

Basic SQL knowledge for application and database-related operational investigations.
Experience with AWS monitoring and logging services, particularly Amazon CloudWatch.
Familiarity with incident, problem, and change management processes in production environments.
Exposure to operational automation, proactive monitoring, alert optimization, and root cause analysis (RCA).
Understanding of cloud infrastructure best practices, including security, reliability, availability, and cost optimization.
Experience supporting containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, or Amazon EKS would be an advantage.
 

While you may already know about Wissen and the company history, here is a quick rundown for you.
About Wissen Technology:
• The Wissen Group was founded in the year 2000. Wissen Technology, a part of Wissen Group, was established in the year 2015.
• Wissen Technology is a specialized technology company that delivers high-end consulting for organizations in the Banking & Finance, Telecom, and Healthcare domains. We help clients build world class products.
• Our workforce consists of 550+ highly skilled professionals, with leadership and senior management executives who have graduated from Ivy League Universities like Wharton, MIT, IITs, IIMs, and NITs and with rich work experience in some of the biggest companies in the world.
• Wissen Technology has grown its revenues by 400% in these five years without any external funding or investments.
• Globally present with offices US, India, UK, Australia, Mexico, and Canada.
• We offer an array of services including Application Development, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Big Data & Analytics, Visualization & Business Intelligence, Robotic Process Automation, Cloud, Mobility, Agile & DevOps, Quality Assurance & Test Automation.
• Wissen Technology has been certified as a Great Place to Work®.
• Wissen Technology has been voted as the Top 20 AI/ML vendor by CIO Insider in 2020.
• Over the years, Wissen Group has successfully delivered $650 million worth of projects for more than 20 of the Fortune 500 companies.
We have served client across sectors like Banking, Telecom, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and Energy. They include likes of Morgan Stanley, MSCI, StateStreet, Flipkart, Swiggy, Trafigura, GE to name a few.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Pragyan Priyadarshini <ppriyadarshini@griddynamics.com>
Date: Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 11:12 AM
Subject: Job Description - Grid Dynamics
To: <nagarajkamath701@gmail.com>


Dear Nagaraj,

Thank you for speaking with me today.

We are excited to share a Job Opportunity @ Grid Dynamics for the position of DevOps Engineer.

Please find the role details below:
We are looking for an experienced SRE / DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience in AWS cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, on-premises infrastructure, and Java-based microservices. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining infrastructure reliability, supporting production applications, troubleshooting issues, automating operational tasks, and ensuring high availability and performance across cloud and on-premises environments.

Key Responsibilities
Manage and support AWS cloud infrastructure and on-premises environments.

Administer and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters, containers, and application deployments.

Support Java-based microservices running in production environments.

Monitor application and infrastructure health, availability, performance, and resource utilization.

Troubleshoot production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventive measures.

Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions.

Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational tasks.

Support CI/CD pipelines and application release deployments.

Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and application teams to improve system reliability and operational efficiency.

Participate in on-call support and incident management activities as required.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SRE, DevOps, or Production Reliability Engineering.

Experience managing AWS cloud infrastructure and services.

Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker in production environments.

Experience supporting on-premises infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments.

Experience troubleshooting and supporting Java-based microservices.

Knowledge of Linux system administration, networking, and infrastructure troubleshooting.

Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, or CloudWatch.

Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.

Knowledge of infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

Strong troubleshooting, incident management, and root cause analysis skills.

Good to Have
Experience with high-availability and distributed systems.

Knowledge of service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), and service-level agreements (SLAs).

Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Shell.

Familiarity with application performance monitoring and JVM troubleshooting.

Experience managing production workloads across cloud and on-premises environments.

Next Steps
A Technical Interview will be scheduled and simultaneously, a HackerRank assessment will be shared.
This will be followed by a Managerial round(in-person)
Finally, a client round.
Additionally, please share the following details:

Current CTC 
Expected CTC
Notice Period / Earliest Joining Date
If you have any questions regarding the opportunity, please feel free to reach out.

We look forward to hearing from you and taking your application forward.

About Us

Grid Dynamics (Nasdaq:GDYN) is a digital-native technology services provider that accelerates growth and bolsters competitive advantage for Fortune 1000 companies. Grid Dynamics provides digital transformation consulting and implementation services in omnichannel customer experience, big data analytics, search, artificial intelligence, cloud migration, and application modernization. Grid Dynamics achieves high speed-to-market, quality, and efficiency by using technology accelerators, an agile delivery culture, and its pool of global engineering talent. Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the US, UK, Netherlands, Mexico, India, Central and Eastern Europe.

To learn more about Grid Dynamics, please visit www.griddynamics.com. Follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn.


Regards,
